title: 我无法通过快捷键使用文本提取器
author: GISer-Qiu
summary: Text Extractor does not activate from its keyboard shortcut, but the report does not describe the configured shortcut, visible response, or whether the module works from Settings.

status.label: Activation evidence needed
status.detail: A focused activation comparison and fresh diagnostic archive are needed to separate shortcut conflict, disabled-module state, and module startup failure.

next_action.label: Request Text Extractor activation details
next_action.reason: The current report does not establish what happens when either activation path is used.

judgment.rationale: The title identifies the failing feature but not the configured input or actual behavior. These details directly determine whether triage should investigate shortcut registration or Text Extractor startup.
evidence: The report states that Text Extractor cannot be used through its shortcut.
No reproduction steps, configured shortcut, screenshot, diagnostic archive, or comparison with Settings activation is supplied.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact shortcut, the observed response, a Settings activation comparison, and a fresh diagnostic archive after reproducing.

issue_context.summary: Text Extractor shortcut activation fails without enough detail to identify the failing activation layer.
known_information: The affected feature is Text Extractor.
The reporter cannot use it through the keyboard shortcut.
inferences: The failure could occur in global shortcut registration, module enablement, or Text Extractor startup; the current evidence does not distinguish them.
issue_context.analysis: Comparing the shortcut with the Settings launch control is the shortest way to isolate shortcut registration from module startup. A fresh diagnostic ZIP is useful only after that controlled attempt.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue, labels, assignees, and timeline.
No attachment, existing maintainer request, duplicate, or linked fix is present.

information_gaps.information: The configured Text Extractor shortcut and exactly what appears when it is pressed.
information_gaps.why_needed: This identifies whether the shortcut is registered and whether activation starts before failing.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Include a screenshot of the Text Extractor shortcut setting and describe any notification, cursor change, selection overlay, or complete lack of response.

information_gaps.information: Whether Text Extractor starts from its activation control in PowerToys Settings.
information_gaps.why_needed: This separates a global-hotkey conflict from a module startup problem.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable Text Extractor, activate it from PowerToys Settings, and report whether the selection overlay appears.

information_gaps.information: Fresh PowerToys diagnostics after reproducing the failure.
information_gaps.why_needed: The log can show shortcut registration conflicts or module launch failures.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Immediately after reproducing, submit a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting the Text Extractor shortcut problem. Please share a screenshot of the configured Text Extractor shortcut and describe exactly what happens when you press it, including whether there is no response, a notification, cursor change, or selection overlay. Also confirm whether Text Extractor starts when activated from PowerToys Settings. Immediately after reproducing the failure, please submit a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP. The Settings comparison will separate a shortcut conflict from a module startup failure, and the fresh logs can identify the failing path.
